text.en: While aiming down sights with a fully drawn Bow, combatants behind walls are highlighted and arrows pierce shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Intrinsically <barrier/>Anti-Barrier.

Aiming Down Sights while fully drawn grants Truesight. Truesight reaches 64 meters.

Buff disappears after 3 seconds or leaving ADS. Bow must be fully redrawn to reactivate Truesight.
